summary: The topology Legend colors node status (Error includes Unavailable) and link states Established, Adding and Removing; clicking a node shows hostname, type and status and links to its Details page to remove it, run a health check or stop jobs being assigned.
questions: What do the link states in the topology view mean?
How do I run a health check on a mesh node?
How do I stop jobs running on a node?
What does an Error node status mean in topology view?
